title: Hinomori Shiho — The Moment I Rise〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Phew... I've been playing for a while now, so I should probably take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want to keep working on that arrangement a bit more, so I'll check it over again after...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already this late?
It's past midnight...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we don't have practice until noon tomorrow, so I guess I can stay up a little tonight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll keep going until I find a good place to stop. After all, we don't have much time left until our show.
The next day

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's morning? What time is it...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A message...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, it's the Leo/need group chat. I've gotten a ton of notifications...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, it's almost noon. I slept in way too much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess that makes sense, since I did stay up pretty late last night. Anyway, what are they talking about?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line:
<Hey!
Is anyone free to have lunch a little early before we head over to the studio?>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <I wanna check out the new fancy cafe that just opened up right near it!>

rows.Speaker: Honami's Message
rows.Line: <I can join you.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <Me too. Why don't we meet up outside the station?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: An early lunch...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even if I were to get ready now, I wouldn't make it in time. But I should still reply.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I just woke up. I won't be able to join you guys, so go on without me. I'll see you all during practice.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <Wait, you just woke up?>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <Wow! Somebody's a sleepyhead!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, not really...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Message
rows.Line:
<Get here safe, okay?
Let us know if it looks like it'll take a little longer.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <Okay, thanks.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yawn... I need to start getting ready.
A few hours later
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're starting to get the hang of this arrangement.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was the most in sync we've been today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Once we hammer out all the little details, this song should be ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is a good stopping point, so why don't we take a break?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we've been practicing for a while... Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. You seem sleepy, Shiho.
Definitely the perfect time for a break.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you woke up just before noon, right? Did you stay up late last night or something?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm pretty sure I fell asleep before morning came around, but I just didn't want to stop practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, this morning...? Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You can rest if you are feeling sleepy.
We can have an extended break.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. And if you get lonely on your own, I can nap with you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You don't have to do that.
I mean, I'd rather sleep by myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! We should have a nap together like old times!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like old times? When are you talking about exactly?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But still... I've really made the three of them worry about me now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wouldn't want to keep them from being able to focus on practice...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should probably stop staying up so late to practice. At least for a while. In return, I'll try to focus more during the day.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho? Are you really sure that you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel more awake now after talking with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank goodness! Let us know if you start feeling sleepy again! We'll be more than happy to talk!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, now that Shiho's feeling better, why don't we resume?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For now, let's keep working on that song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Agreed. We've gotten the hang of it, but we need to make sure our sounds don't clash or overlap. Why don't we start there?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm hoping that we'll finish working on this arrangement today. I know that's a big ask, but let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: Honami, Saki & Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!
